blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (Path traversal in read_attachment through the client-supplied name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
path = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, str(ticket_id), name)
with open(path, "rb") as f:
findings.recommendation: Validate `name` where it enters (CWE-22): reject it unless it equals `os.path.basename(name)` and is not empty, `.` or `..`, or better, look it up in the `attachments` table for this `ticket_id` and open only the stored name; then resolve the path with `os.path.realpath` and check it stays under the ticket's directory. Add a test that `../`, absolute and other-ticket names are refused.
findings.title: Path traversal in read_attachment through the client-supplied name

findings.title: save_attachment enforces no authorization on the ticket written to
